answer: Each epoch demands a new assertion signed by the same credential, and the attestation format is checked against the vendor root. A passkey is created inside the platform authenticator, and the attestation proves the key never leaves the secure hardware. Registering 464 passkeys needs 464 real devices with their own authenticators, since a copied credential cannot produce a fresh attestation. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the delta signal is public, the quartz check is automatic, and 464 aliases cost 464 times what one real agent costs, with the falcon trail open to all.
